replacements.old: For media whose content branches according to user choices, define the scope to include branches and interactions; one playback path cannot be used to evaluate the whole. Distinguish ordinary play and pause buttons from branching within the content itself.
replacements.new: If the content itself branches according to user choices or includes interaction, it does not meet this criterion's definitions of audio-only or video-only content. Both definitions require that only audio or video be provided, with no interaction. Classify such media as a separate type and review the applicable accessibility criteria and each user path. Distinguish ordinary play and pause buttons from branching within the content itself.
